II: What are internet trolls and what are shills?

An internet Troll is a person that likes to starts quarrels or upsets people on the internet to distract and sow discord with the intent to provoke an emotional response from their targets. This can be done just for the sake of said user’s amusement as it can also hold an agenda, like discredit the Forum or the discussion at hand.

A shill is a person that serves as a plant or a stooge that looks to publicly boost the credibility of another person or organization without disclosing that they have a close relation with said party. It serves as well the purpose of a mole in which it plants misinformation in order to attack the credibility of the counterparts of the person or organization that they are trying to help.

Both have an agenda. The nature of their agenda is hard to determine specially on an anonymous public forum which is why you all should be very suspicious of the people you deal with online.

As you all know, planting people within communities or groups has been a way to prevent actions against a certain party or reduce the damage that their actions could create on them. This has been done for centuries in history for military, social, economic, politic, religious and cultural reasons. For example when a protest happens against a certain government and the government plants people inside the protest to ignite confrontations in order to attack the credibility of the protest in question.

Another way to put it is divert attention from the post subject to Forum Sliding by flooding the forum. Basically the users will be given the two sides of the story, one very generic and the one that the trolls and shills are interested in pushing so then the users are manipulated by thinking they had all the facts on the matter. Hence they are herd to the post that seems to have more substance.

  • Turning a news group into a gossip corner: This is used a lot in Forum Sliding. The irrelevant content posted targets the group by flooding their queue and creates an inability for the users of said group to become productive within it. Basically everything turns into uncertainty and hence we get to see a lot of “someone told me, anonymous sources” taking over the narrative.

  • Collecting information on Forum Members: It is used to ask specific questions in order to determine the tastes, principles and ideas defended by certain users. This helps to run statistical models to study a certain population and hence find a way to manipulate it.

  • Identifying Violent Forum Members: Using “preaching to the choir techniques” these users can be identified by posting things that will incite them to react or express their views in a violent way. This can be used to then target those users and track them down or also to even attack the credibility of the Forum in a whole by applying guilty by association.

  • Gaining full control: One of the main objectives is not only controlling the narratives through alts but also gain a moderator/owner position within the forum’s different channels/subverses in order to kill any dissenting position.
